class.name: ChorusExecution
class.description: Controls whether inference may run alongside other work on the same engine. Set [member ChorusInferenceRequest.execution] before submission. This does not change session ownership: a session can still have only one active inference request.

constants.constant: Allows the provider to schedule this request alongside other shared requests.
Runs without other inference requests active on the same engine. Queued work waits until the exclusive request finishes.
